title: Log: promote provider selection success logs from pr_debug to pr_info_ratelimited
description: fd.c: successful provider selection is logged at pr_debug for INIT (line 802), KEY_IMPORT (1703), and KEY_GENERATE (2077). In production these are invisible. A support engineer investigating a closed session has no kernel-side record of which provider was selected. GET_STATE helps only while the fd is still open. Fix: change all three to pr_info_ratelimited so every session init leaves a ring buffer trace.
